name: GAEA-Bench
description:
GAEA: A Geolocation Aware Conversational Assistant [WACV 2026🔥]

 Summary

 Image geolocalization, in which an AI model traditionally predicts the precise GPS coordinates of an image, is a challenging task with many downstream applications. However, the user cannot utilize the model to further their knowledge beyond the GPS coordinates; the model lacks an understanding of the location and the conversational ability to communicate with the user. evaluation_method: VQA accuracy; geolocation error (median/mean distance); human evaluation for conversational quality
general_score_metric: median geolocation error (distance) and VQA accuracy
reputation: New WACV 2026 benchmark aimed at combining geolocation and conversational evaluation; early-stage adoption in geolocation/conversational multimodal research.
